legend: Iahub is a big fan of tourists. He wants to become a tourist himself, so he planned a trip. There are n destinations on a straight road that Iahub wants to visit. Iahub starts the excursion from kilometer 0. The n destinations are described by a non-negative integers sequence a1, a2, ..., an. The number ak represents that the kth destination is at distance ak kilometers from the starting point. No two destinations are located in the same place.

Iahub wants to visit each destination only once. Note that, crossing through a destination is not considered visiting, unless Iahub explicitly wants to visit it at that point. Also, after Iahub visits his last destination, he doesn't come back to kilometer 0, as he stops his trip at the last destination.

The distance between destination located at kilometer x and next destination, located at kilometer y, is |x - y| kilometers. We call a "route" an order of visiting the destinations. Iahub can visit destinations in any order he wants, as long as he visits all n destinations and he doesn't visit a destination more than once.

Iahub starts writing out on a paper all possible routes and for each of them, he notes the total distance he would walk. He's interested in the average number of kilometers he would walk by choosing a route. As he got bored of writing out all the routes, he asks you to help him.
input: The first line contains integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 105). Next line contains n distinct integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 107).
output: Output two integers — the numerator and denominator of a fraction which is equal to the wanted average number. The fraction must be irreducible.

legend.ai: Iahub 是一名旅游爱好者。他想亲自成为一名游客，因此计划了一次旅行。有一条笔直的道路，路上有 n 个 Iahub 想要参观的目的地。Iahub 从 0 千米处开始这次旅行。这 n 个目的地由一个非负整数序列 a1, a2, ..., an 描述。数值 ak 表示第 k 个目的地距离起点 ak 千米。任意两个目的地都不在同一位置。
Iahub 希望每个目的地只参观一次。注意，经过某个目的地并不算参观，除非 Iahub 明确想在经过该处时参观它。此外，在参观完最后一个目的地后，Iahub 不会返回 0 千米处，而是将旅行终点设在最后一个目的地。
位于 x 千米处的目的地与下一个位于 y 千米处的目的地之间的距离为 |x - y| 千米。我们将参观各个目的地的顺序称为一条“路线”。Iahub 可以按照任意顺序参观目的地，只要他参观所有 n 个目的地，且不会重复参观任何一个目的地。
Iahub 开始在纸上写下所有可能的路线，并为每条路线记录他需要行走的总距离。他想知道选择一条路线时所行走距离的平均值。由于写下所有路线让他感到厌烦，因此他请你帮助他。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 105）。第二行包含 n 个互不相同的整数 a1, a2, ..., an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 107）。

output.ai: 输出两个整数——一个分数的分子和分母，该分数等于所求的平均距离。这个分数必须是最简分数。
